frequency_question: What proportion of major domestic defense manufacturing setup initiatives for advanced guided munitions in wartime achieve operational status within 15 months?
membership_rule: Includes any documented historical case of a nation attempting to set up indigenous production or deep assembly of advanced foreign cruise missiles or precision-guided munitions during an ongoing major conventional war. Excludes basic small arms, ammunition, or unguided artillery manufacturing.

cases.name: Iran-to-Yemen/Hezbollah localized ballistic/cruise missile assembly facilitation
Ukraine domestic Vilkha/Neptune missile scaling post-2022 invasion
Russia domestic Iranian-design Shahed (Geran-2) UAV production establishment

coverage_note: 3 named cases representing the class of wartime expedited guided weapon manufacturing localization; highly restricted class due to the scarcity of peer-to-peer modern missile tech transfers.
known_gaps: Class is small because sovereign states rarely attempt to domesticate western cruise missiles like SCALP/Storm Shadow mid-war due to extreme IP, specialized metallurgy, and clean-room optical seeker requirements.
skeleton: Cases of advanced guided weapon technology transfer requiring high-precision guidance and propulsion systems established under wartime constraints
multiplier: 1 successful operational setup (Shahed/Geran-2 UAVs, though lower tech than a cruise missile) out of 3 major documented attempts at rapid domestic guided munition localization during conflict
validity_reason: The underlying constraints of supply chain physics, clean-room construction timelines, and specialized machine tool procurement remain constant over this technological horizon.
